cues: To find how much sulphate is in a solution, we add barium chloride.
Barium sulphate is almost completely insoluble, so it comes out as a white precipitate.
text: Here is the gravimetric route. To find how much sulphate is in a solution, we add barium chloride. Barium sulphate is almost completely insoluble, so it comes out as a white precipitate.
